Methods. Our reference implementation is https://example.org/engine.git at commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567, with benchmark manifest inference-bench.json and model revision 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. We measure benchmark throughput-c8 on one NVIDIA H100 using bfloat16. The synthetic workload uses concurrency 8, 1000 measured requests after 100 warmup requests, 1024 input tokens and 256 output tokens per request, temperature 0, and random seed 42. Output-token throughput is the total generated output tokens divided by the measured interval in seconds, excluding warmup.

Results and reproduction. Under these exact conditions, the implementation produces at least 1000 output tokens per second.
